user.title: Cook Manager
user.description: Choose the probes to cook with. Everything here can be changed later.

data_description.slots: How many cooks can run at once.
data_description.probes: Temperature sensors to offer as meat or grill probes. A climate entity is read through its current temperature.
data_description.grill_controllers: Optional. Climate entities from other integrations that are handed the grill target (for example a fan controller). They keep doing their own regulation.
data_description.notify_services: Notify services used when a cook is set to notify everyone, and as the fallback when the person who started a cook has no phone with the Home Assistant app.
data_description.ignored_readings: Comma-separated values a probe reports when nothing is plugged in, for example -1.
data_description.pre_alert: Alert this many degrees before a meat target.
data_description.grill_tolerance: Alert when the grill is this far above or below its target.
data_description.ikamand_hosts: Optional. IP address of a Kamado Joe iKamand on your network, for example 192.168.1.50. Cook Manager then talks to it directly: its pit and food probes join the probes, and it becomes a grill controller. Separate several with commas.
data_description.alerts: Alerts that are sent as notifications. All of them still fire as cook_manager_event events.
data_description.notify_url: Optional. Dashboard path opened when a phone notification is tapped, for example /lovelace/bbq.

start_cook.name: Start cook
start_cook.description: Start a cook in a slot. Fields left out keep what the slot already has.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the cook, used in alerts.

grill_controller.name: Grill controller
grill_controller.description: Climate entity that is handed the grill target, for example the iKamand.

doneness.name: Doneness
doneness.description: Doneness id or name from the recipe.

weight.name: Weight
weight.description: Weight of the meat in kilograms. Stored with the cook record.

stop_cook.name: Stop cook
stop_cook.description: Stop the cook in a slot.

next_stage.name: Next stage
next_stage.description: Move the cook in a slot to its next stage.
